page: Microsoft Azure NV12ads_V710_v5 is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine belonging to the NVadsV710v5 family. It features an x86_64 AMD processor with 12 dedicated vCPUs and 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 5.33 GB of RAM per core. The instance runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

This server configuration includes a fractional GPU allocation of 0.5 of an AMD V710 GPU, providing 11 GB of dedicated VRAM. For local storage, the instance is equipped with 825 GB of local disk capacity and is Premium Storage capable, allowing for high-performance external disk attachments.

By utilizing a fractional GPU, this instance offers a cost-efficient entry point for workloads that require GPU acceleration but do not need a full dedicated GPU card. This resource density makes it suitable for virtual desktops, moderate 3D rendering, machine learning inference, and graphics-intensive applications that benefit from hardware acceleration without the cost of a whole GPU.
